tests.previous_answer_checks: Syntax/divide-by-zero/range errors preserve expression, caret, selection and previous rounded answer; current becomes false; edits and Escape retain previous; C clears it; full-buffer failure preserves source; successful correction replaces previous.
tests.fraction_oracle_method: Python Fraction exact rationals, built-in rational half-even rounding and independently tokenized shunting-yard operator evaluator; checks raw, sticky rounded and canonical formatted string.
tests.fraction_oracle_error_limit: Differential corpus checks rejected versus accepted status for all error cases; it does not enforce ordering or exact kind when several subexpressions can fail.
tests.boundary_cases_method: Targeted independently specified exact error kinds, length/depth boundaries, full 256-byte zero literals, unsupported Unicode/control bytes, rounded-zero division, overflow-before-compensation and signed ties; successful values use Fraction oracle.

conclusion: Bounded pass: no concrete reachable math/grammar/previous-answer finding identified.

source_checks.observation: Sign separated for division; exact remainder implements symmetric half-even; bounded raw output checked.
Product precedence and left-associative binary loops; combined unary/parentheses depth limit32 and input byte limit256.
Raw operands <=10^19-1 ensure product<10^38<i128::MAX; checked multiplication and result bounds remain explicit.
Literal scanning is finite, checks integer range and performs ninth-place half-even using sticky discarded digits.
Arithmetic errors retain previous answer and invalidate current; Reset clears answer, Cancel retains it.
